subject.title: [Bug]: browser upload/file chooser flow is flaky and can misreport stale-click failures as browser control timeouts

question: Should Browser upload keep paths-only arm-then-later-click as a supported workflow, or should agent/tool behavior move toward atomic upload-with-trigger for dynamic pages?
rationale: Both paths-only arming and atomic upload-with-ref are current, documented or tested behavior, and changing the default improves reliability but may affect callers that deliberately arm before a later trigger.

options.title: Compatibility-first atomic preference
options.body: Keep paths-only arming supported, but update agent/tool guidance and timeout/error handling to prefer the existing atomic trigger path when a trigger is known.

options.title: Require a trigger for upload
options.body: Retire paths-only arming for agent/tool upload flows and require `ref`, `inputRef`, or `element`, with migration guidance for delayed-trigger callers.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and document stale-ref recovery plus selector/batch mitigations, accepting that this flake can remain possible.

recommendation.title: Compatibility-first atomic preference
recommendation.body: Keep paths-only arming supported, but update agent/tool guidance and timeout/error handling to prefer the existing atomic trigger path when a trigger is known.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history for the Browser upload helper, route split, and dispatcher error context points to Peter Steinberger.
